_comment: Ideologies to audit: articles linked from English Wikipedia's List of political ideologies (see scripts/ideology-candidates.js), plus earlier entries that have their own Wikipedia article or a redirect to one. Each id has an audit at audits/profiles/<id>.json once researched. An optional scopeNote is passed to the auditor to pin down what the profile covers.

ideologies.name: National Socialism
ideologies.scopeNote: Profile the ideology's doctrine as set out in its own texts and program, not the Nazi Party as an organization or the Third Reich's historical record. Use plain colors only; no flags or symbols.
